name: V3 deterministic actual-scheduler economy simulation (30 days)
description: Advances due registered server cron handlers through the deterministic QA clock. Captures daily balances, bank and corporation transaction totals by type, planetary and port stocks, population, remainders, reward counts and invariants. No gameplay rates are modified.

tests.name: Authenticate isolated SysOp clock operator
Move enabled deadlines into future before activating simulated time

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET next_due_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+INTERVAL '1 hour' WHERE enabled=TRUE;

tests.name: Enable test-only deterministic scheduler switch

data.sql: INSERT INTO config(key,value,type) VALUES('test.deterministic_scheduler_enabled','1','int') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=EXCLUDED.value,type='int';

tests.name: Advance actual registered scheduler to simulated day 01
Capture day 01 accounting and invariant snapshot

data.sql: SELECT jsonb_build_object('player_credits',(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(credits),0) FROM players),'corporation_credits',(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance),0) FROM corp_accounts),'bank_balances',(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance),0) FROM bank_accounts WHERE is_active=TRUE),'planet_stock',(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity),0) FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet'),'port_stock',(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity),0) FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='port'),'planet_population',(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(population),0) FROM planets),'production_remainders',(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(ore_production_remainder,0)+COALESCE(organics_production_remainder,0)+COALESCE(equipment_production_remainder,0)+COALESCE(fighter_production_remainder,0)),0) FROM planets),'ferengi_rewards',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ferengi_destruction_rewards),'bank_flow_by_mechanism',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(k,total),'{}'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT tx_type||':'||direction AS k,SUM(amount) AS total FROM bank_transactions GROUP BY tx_type,direction) f),'corporation_flow_by_mechanism',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(k,total),'{}'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT kind AS k,SUM(amount) AS total FROM corp_tx GROUP BY kind) c),'planetary_production_events',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM planet_economic_activity),'planetary_output',(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity),0) FROM planet_economic_activity))::text,CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM players WHERE credits<0) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM corp_accounts WHERE balance<0) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bank_accounts WHERE balance<0) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM entity_stock WHERE quantity<0) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM planets WHERE population<0) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM port_hardware_stock WHERE stock_quantity<0 OR stock_quantity>max_stock) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
